# Snell v5 interoperability fixture

`surge-v5-initial.bin` is the publicly documented Surge v5 HTTP/3 packet
fixture from missuo/opensnell, commit
`3100984fd7c3a2bd7b41e292ad41f10d928bfb2d`,
`components/snell/quic_test_fixture.go`.
Source: https://github.com/missuo/opensnell
License: GPL-3.0-or-later (compatible with this repository).
The associated public test PSK is `JFdZLmZLtYtUP308QrqdoA==`; it is test data,
not a deployment credential. The decoded target is www.cloudflare.com:443.
